sql: select e.key as experiment, e.state, v.version, ep.epoch_number, ep.ended_at as epoch_ended, d.deployment_key, d.kind, string_agg(a.strategy_tag, ',') as tags from experiment_deployments d join experiment_epochs ep on ep.id = d.epoch_id join experiment_versions v on v.id = ep.version_id join experiments e on e.id = v.experiment_id left join experiment_deployment_arms a on a.deployment_id = d.id where d.ended_at is null and ep.ended_at is not null group by 1,2,3,4,5,6,7 order by ep.ended_at
